an7.50:1.1: athakho jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an7.50:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.50:1.4: yañhi taṃ brāhmaṇa sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an7.50:1.5: akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caratīti mameva taṃ brāhmaṇa sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an7.50:1.6: ahañhi brāhmaṇa akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carāmīti.
an7.50:1.7: kiṃ pana bho gotama brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampīti.
an7.50:2.1: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno naheva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayandvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati
an7.50:2.2: apica kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ sādiyati
an7.50:2.3: so taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati
an7.50:2.4: idampi kho brāhmaṇa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampi
an7.50:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saññutto methunena saññogena na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.50:3.1: puna caparaṃ brāhmaṇa idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno naheva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayandvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati napi mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ sādiyati
an7.50:3.2: apica kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkeḷāyati …pe…
an7.50:4.1: napi mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkeḷāyati
an7.50:4.2: apica kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati
an7.50:5.1: napi mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati
an7.50:5.2: apica kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā
an7.50:6.1: napi mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā
an7.50:6.2: apica kho yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni tāni anussarati
an7.50:7.1: napi yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni tāni anussarati
an7.50:7.2: apica kho passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ
an7.50:8.1: napi passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ
an7.50:8.2: apica kho aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti
an7.50:8.3: so taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati
an7.50:8.4: idampi kho brāhmaṇa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampi
an7.50:8.5: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saññutto methunena saññogena na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.50:9.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaññogānaṃ aññataraṃ methunasaññogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ samanupassiṃ neva tāvāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ
an7.50:10.1: yato ca kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaññogānaṃ aññataraṃ methunasaññogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ na samanupassiṃ athāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ
an7.50:10.3: akuppā me vimutti ayamantimā jāti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
an7.50:11.1: evaṃ vutte jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.50:11.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
